result.title: Retrieval Over Training: Similarity search-based Model Selection for Time Series Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Anomaly detection is a fundamental task for time-series analytics, with important implications for the downstream performance of many applications. Despite the large number of anomaly detection methods proposed in the literature, recent benchmark studies have shown that no single detector performs best across highly heterogeneous time series. Therefore, a practical and scalable solution is to develop a model-selection method that, for a given time series, selects the anomaly detector most likely to perform well. Nevertheless, the model selection approaches proposed in the literature suffer from a significant drop in accuracy when applied in Out-of-Distribution (OOD) settings. In this paper, we tackle the aforementioned limitation and propose RAMSAD, a retrieval-based framework for model selection in time-series anomaly detection. Given a new time series, our method queries a knowledge base of previously observed instances, retrieves the top-k most similar series, and transfers detector recommendations from their performance profiles. The framework can operate with standard similarity measures as well as embedding-based representations. Our results show that RAMSAD outperforms existing baselines in In-Distribution (ID) settings and is the most robust selector in OOD, where, when selecting a small subset of detectors, it matches or exceeds ensembles that run the entire detector pool, at a fraction of their cost. Overall, we demonstrate that similarity-based retrieval constitutes a strong and efficient foundation for model selection in time-series anomaly detection.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RAMSAD：给定新时间序列，在历史实例知识库中按相似度检索 top-k 序列，迁移其检测器性能记录以完成模型选择，在分布外设置下比现有选择器更稳健，且以更低成本接近全检测器集成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相似度检索 + 历史性能迁移」的思路，可能为 LVR 中按 latent 相似度筛选证据或选择计算路径/假设提供类比；但该文面向时间序列异常检测器选择，与多模态推理状态的关联仍属推测，需核查其表示与检索粒度是否有借鉴价值。
